description: Checks whether the Adobe Connect desktop application is installed and, if not, installs it silently for all users from Adobe's MSI. Exit code 10 means it was already installed.
symptoms: I need Adobe Connect to join an online class or meeting
ادوبی کانکت روی سیستم نصب نیست
برای کلاس آنلاین به Adobe Connect نیاز دارم

review.source: Adobe Connect application MSI for enterprise deployment from Adobe's Connect downloads page.
review.notes: Installer not committed. Place it with scripts/set-package-files.ps1 -Id adobe-connect-install -File <path to the MSI> -Sign; it is stored as AdobeConnect.msi.
